seo_title: B2B SEPA Direct Debit API: Automate Your Bank Collections
seo_desc: Wasting days generating XML files for the bank? We integrate a cloud API to automate your SEPA direct debits and collect payments without errors.
author_pitch: I have seen small business managers lose sleep over a rejected bank file. My mission is to connect your management system directly to the bank through cloud interfaces, making your monthly receipt collection completely automatic and secure.
title: SEPA API Integration: Eradicate Manual Work from Your Bank Remittances
body:
Does your administration manager spend the first days of the month fighting with XML files just to charge your clients?

Charging via direct debit is vital to secure revenue for your service company, but the process is an administrative torture. Generating spreadsheet lists, running them through obsolete programs to create the SEPA file, and uploading it to the bank's website is slow and highly prone to failure. If a single account number has a blank space, the bank rejects the entire batch, delaying the collection of all your billing and suffocating your business's liquidity.

The trap of spreadsheet converters

Many businesses try to speed up this work by using free internet tools to convert their tables into banking formats, exposing their clients' financial data to third parties. Risking your buyers' privacy to save time is a negligence that will destroy your reputation.

Our solution: Cloud API Integration for Remittances

At LANZAESTUDIO, we build a secure digital bridge between your current management software and your bank's gateway, automating the creation and sending of receipts without anyone having to download or export a single file.

  1. Automatic XML Generation: Our cloud interface extracts pending fees from your system and generates the SEPA banking file with pinpoint accuracy.
  2. Prior Account Validation: The system automatically checks the structure of IBAN codes before sending, preventing massive rejections due to typos.
  3. Direct Bank Connection: We send the collection orders directly to your financial institution through secure and end-to-end encrypted channels.
  4. Real-Time Status Updates: Your database receives instant confirmation when a receipt has been successfully collected or if it has bounced due to insufficient funds.

The Real Impact on Your Company's Administration

  • Zero Collection Delays: You guarantee that your clients' money enters your bank account on the exact correct day, protecting your monthly liquidity.
  • Elimination of Repetitive Tasks: Your administrative team stops typing account numbers and dedicates that time to tasks that actually add value and sales to your business.
  • Maximum Financial Security: You strictly comply with European data protection regulations by not having files with bank accounts circulating uncontrolled around your office.
